buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER-ADDED BID SPECIFIC ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. Scope of Work (Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning - SITC) The bidder’s quoted price must include all cost components: Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning, cabling, conduit piping, and civil works required for the CCTV cases/cameras. CCTV Cases / Housing Specs: All outdoor cameras and accessories must be housed in weatherproof IP-66 / IP-67 rated environmental housings (aluminium or equivalent robust material) with sun-shrouds. The came ra mount must be fully compatible with the specific camera model. The Seller may quote items of same or better specifications. The bidder is responsible for the complete integration of the supplied components with the existing IT/Surv eillance infrastructure of the buyer. 2. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF)

Bidders (if not the OEM) must upload a valid, bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) from the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for major components (CCTV Cameras, NVR/VMS, and specialized housings). The MAF must explicitly state the GeM Bid Number and guarantee back-to-back technical support and warr anty replacements. 3. Make in India (MII) & Land Border Compliance Land Border Restriction: Any bidder from a country that shares a land border with India will be eligible to b id only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority (DPIIT) as per Ministry of Finance guidelines . Bidders must upload a compliance undertaking. Trusted Source / Cyber Security: Offered products must be clear of malicious code, backdoors, or trojans. CCTV cameras and cases must comply with Government of India directives regarding non-procurement fro m restricted neighboring countries. 4. Quality & Certifications The OEM must possess valid ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001 certifications. Products offered must not be obsolete. The OEM must declare that the product will have a minimum residu al market life 5 years and that spare parts will be available for at least 5 years. Bidders must upload the exact Data Sheet of the product(s) offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters with the provided Data Sheet, the bid is liable for technical rejection. 5. Option Clause The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered by up to 25% of the bi d quantity at the time of placement of the contract, or during the currency of the contract, at the contracte d rates. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity. 6. Warranty & Comprehensive Maintenance Warranty Period: The supplied CCTV cases, cameras, and related IT hardware must carry a minimum of 3 Y ears On-Site Comprehensive OEM Warranty from the date of final acceptance (CRAC). Service Level Agreement (SLA): The bidder must provide a dedicated Toll-Free number or a centralized hel pdesk portal. Any hardware fault must be resolved/replaced within 48 hours of complaint registration. Functional Service Centre: The bidder or OEM must have a functional service center in the Consignee’s Sta te to ensure rapid response. Documentary evidence of the service center (address and contact details) mu st be uploaded. 7. Pre-Bid Site Survey Bidders are requested to carry out site survey to understand the cabling, mounting, and casing requireme nts etc. Integration of existing CCTV setup is scope of work. Certificate on 100 Rupees stamp paper is requ ired to be uploaded mentioning that “We the participant bidder have understood the buyers requirement a nd we will carry out the project as per their requirement including installation, finishing work, repair/maint of Inadvertent sabotage etc at buyer’s location (HC Wg, AWC, Mhow) without any extra charges.” Failing w hich the bidder liable to be rejected at TEC stage 8. Payment Terms No Advance Payment will be made. 100% payment will be released within the standard GeM timeline after the generation of the Consignee Re ceipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) on GeM, subject to the successful testing, commissioning, and rec eipt of the physical Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG). While generating the invoice on the GeM portal, the seller must upload a scanned copy of the GST invoice a

nd a screenshot of the GST portal confirming the payment of GST. 9. EMD and Performance Bank Guarantee (ePBG) EMD as per schedule. Original EMD must be reached to this office before technical bid opening date. Failin g which the bidder will be liable to be rejected. Successful bidders must submit an ePBG of 5% of the total contract value valid for the entire warranty period plus an additional 2 months (Total 26 months if the warr anty is 2 years). MSEs (Micro and Small Enterprises) (Only OEM) and Startups recognized by DPIIT are exempted from sub mitting EMD as per GoI guidelines, provided they submit valid registration certificates for the exact catego ry of goods/services being procured. Traders/Resellers claiming MSE benefits will not be accepted. 10. Malicious Code Certificate The seller must upload a declaration on their letterhead stating: "The supplied hardware/software contains no malicious code, backdoor, or trojan that could compromise the security of the surveillance data or the b uyer's network." 11. STQC Certification (MeitY Compliance) · The offered CCTV cameras and critical surveillance components must possess a valid STQC (Standa rdisation Testing and Quality Certification) certificate issued by the STQC Directorate, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. · The bidder must upload a clear, scanned copy of the valid STQC certificate for the specific OEM/brand and models being offered in the bid. · Any bid failing to submit the valid STQC certificate, or submitting an expired certificate, will be consid ered technically non-responsive and shall be summarily rejected. 12. Sample of each item to be provided before starting of the work. Confirmation to be taken from th e user. Sample will be evaluated as per specification. 13. If bidder fails to submit any documents the buyer has right to reject bid without assigning any reas ons there over. 14 OEM Compliance (Technical Compliance on OEM Letterhead) along with make & model No. must be submitted along with the bid. 15. Technical data sheet duly filled, signed and stamped must be submitted. Failing which the bidder w ill liable to be rejected. 16. Undertaking certificate on 100 Rupees stamp paper that bidder / OEM has not been blacklisted in l ast five years from any Govt Dept. 17. Police verification of proprietor/partners issued within 6 months be uploaded with the technical bid documents. Original police verification can be asked by the buyer, if required. .
